spec_family.name: Interior Cabinet Repaint (Combined Prime + Finish)
spec_family.description: Combined prime+finish repaint spec for previously painted or factory-finished interior cabinets in occupied residential homes. Covers condition assessment (visual inspect, ASTM D3359 adhesion test, 4-solvent coating identification, moisture check, thermofoil go/no-go gate, lead screening), kitchen grease degreasing (mandatory), condition-driven prep (degloss, scrape, feather, damage repair, caulk assess/replace, contamination treatment), double-dimension primer routing (condition_scale + factory_finish_type — adhesion, bonding, stain-block, mildew), post-primer adhesion test gate, fine-finish coat application (spray or brush), between-coat interstage at all tiers, two-mobilization workflow (paint + 5-7 day cure + reinstall), and customer walkthrough. 4 paintable items: ITM_CABINET_DOOR (EA), ITM_CABINET_DRAWER (EA), ITM_CABINET_FRAME (SF conditional on scope), ITM_CABINET_INTERIOR (SF conditional on scope=full_with_interior, always QT3). Highest-complexity interior RP spec.

includes: Kitchen cabinets (upper, lower, pantry, island) — previously painted or factory-finished
Bathroom vanity cabinets
Laundry room and utility cabinets
Mudroom cabinets (cabinet-style construction with doors/drawers)

Condition assessment — visual inspection, ASTM D3359 adhesion test, 4-solvent coating ID (mineral spirits/xylene/denatured alcohol/acetone), moisture check, thermofoil go/no-go gate, lead screening (pre-1978)
Kitchen grease degreasing — TSP/degreaser wash, mandatory for all kitchen cabinet RP
Cabinet doors — all styles: slab, shaker, raised panel, glass frame (frame only, glass excluded)
Cabinet drawer front faces
Face frames (stiles, rails), end panels, toe kicks, filler strips
Cabinet interiors (conditional on scope=full_with_interior, always QT3, spray-only)
Hardware removal with paint scoring (painted-over RP hardware), bag, label, reinstall after cure
Door and drawer removal, label, flat painting on sawhorses, reinstallation after 5-7 day cure
Mechanical degloss (existing semi-gloss/gloss finish) + chemical degloss for profiled doors
Scrape loose/failing paint, feather-sand edges (FAIR/POOR condition)
Damage repair — dings, scratches, impact damage, hardware relocation holes
Caulk assess and replace at cabinet-to-wall joints (15-30% failed sections typical)
Contamination treatment — mildew biocide (moisture damage), smoke/nicotine pre-treatment wash
State-driven + factory-finish-type-driven primer selection and application (4 RP primer systems)
Post-primer adhesion test gate (verify bonding before finish coats)
Fine-finish coat application (spray or brush) — 2 coats QT3-QT4, 3 coats QT5 brush per FFD 15.10.3
Between-coat interstage (inspect, sand, patch, spot coat, tack) at ALL quality tiers
Floor protection (full kitchen for spray, perimeter for brush)
Countertop protection (CRITICAL high-value surfaces — kraft/rosin paper + plastic)
Backsplash masking, wall/ceiling masking (spray), appliance protection (ALWAYS in RP)
Plumbing/electrical masking
Cabinet contents verification (homeowner empties, painter verifies)
Hinge alignment adjustment after reinstallation (RP-specific — paint build-up)
Contents replacement coordination with homeowner
Customer walkthrough with per-door/drawer inspection (RP-specific)
EPA Lead-Safe RRP evaluation and containment (pre-1978 homes — cabinets are HIGH RISK for lead paint)

excludes.item: Built-in bookshelves, entertainment centers, mudroom cubbies (open shelving)
Plumbing disconnect for sink base (GC responsibility)
Drawer box interiors (functional surfaces, not cosmetic)

configuration_dimensions.description: Quality tier controlling coat count, inspection rigor, interstage sanding discipline, repair scope, and material system.
configuration_dimensions.notes: QT3 standard residential. QT4 premium — waterborne alkyd STRONGLY recommended. QT5 showroom — premium product mandatory, spray preferred. Cabinet interiors always QT3 regardless of exterior tier (AWI semi-exposed standard). QT modifiers: QT3=1.0x, QT4=1.30x, QT5=1.50x.

configuration_dimensions.description: Primary application technique for primer and finish coats.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Spray strongly preferred per Fine Finish Doctrine SS10.3 and SS15.1.2. Brush method uses Roll and Tip technique per SS15.6. Cabinet interiors are spray-only. Roll is NOT valid for cabinets.

configuration_dimensions.description: Finish sheen. Constrained by quality tier gate.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Semi-gloss is kitchen/bath standard for cleanability. Gloss requires QT5 + spray method.

configuration_dimensions.description: Input substrate condition. All 5 SS_INT_* states accepted.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Each state drives distinct prep pathway and primer selection. Different cabinet components may have different substrate states — worst state at component level drives condition_scale. SS_INT_SOUND_PAINT with passing adhesion test and latex existing may skip prime entirely.

configuration_dimensions.description: Universal 3-level condition scale driving prep intensity. Maps from substrate state assessment.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Prep pool modifier: GOOD=1.0x, FAIR=1.5x, POOR=2.5x (higher than wall/trim RP 2.0x because cabinet failure remediation involves 4 item types across different orientations).

configuration_dimensions.description: Cabinet painting scope — which item groups are active.
configuration_dimensions.notes: doors_only = ITM_CABINET_DOOR + ITM_CABINET_DRAWER only. full_exterior = doors + drawers + frame. full_with_interior = full exterior + ITM_CABINET_INTERIOR.
slab=1.0x, shaker=1.15x, raised_panel=1.30x, glass_frame=1.20x. Applies to door/drawer tasks only. Raised panel has deepest profile — hardest to degloss and paint.

paintable_items.name: Cabinet door face
paintable_items.counting_rules: Each door face counted individually. Removed from cabinet, painted flat on sawhorses/pyramids. Style complexity handled by door_style modifier.
paintable_items.notes: Existing item from SF_CABINET_NC_PAINT. Same physical item in RP context.

paintable_items.name: Cabinet drawer front face
paintable_items.counting_rules: Each drawer front face counted individually. Removed from cabinet, painted flat on sawhorses. ~0.7x door time per unit.
paintable_items.notes: Existing item from SF_CABINET_NC_PAINT. Drawer box interior NOT painted.

paintable_items.name: Cabinet face frame and exposed box surfaces
paintable_items.counting_rules: Total SF of paintable face frame and exposed box surfaces: stiles, rails, end panels, toe kicks, filler strips. Painted in-place after doors/drawers removed.
paintable_items.notes: Existing item from SF_CABINET_NC_PAINT. Height modifier applies for upper cabinets in tall rooms.

paintable_items.name: Cabinet box interior surfaces
paintable_items.counting_rules: Total SF of cabinet interior surfaces — inside walls, ceiling, floor of cabinet box, fixed shelves. Spray-only. Always QT3 regardless of exterior tier (AWI semi-exposed standard).
paintable_items.notes: Existing item from SF_CABINET_NC_PAINT. Separate line item for independent pricing.

variants.notes: BASELINE. Most common residential cabinet repaint. Cosmetic color change on sound latex. Degloss + 2 spray finish coats, no prime. Adhesion verified.
Premium refresh on sound latex. Waterborne alkyd recommended. No prime needed.
Standard RP on failing paint or oil-based existing finish. Scrape + feather + state-driven prime + 2 spray finish coats.
Premium remediation spray. Full prep + state-driven prime + 2 spray finish coats. Waterborne alkyd recommended.
Full remediation on peeling/smoke-damaged cabinets. Heavy scrape, contamination treatment, state-driven prime + 2 finish coats.
Standard brush on sound paint. Minimal room masking. Roll and Tip technique.
Premium brush remediation. Full prep + prime + 2 brush finish coats.
Showroom refresh on sound paint. QT5 spray: 2 finish coats standard. Premium product mandatory.
Showroom brush on sound paint. 3 finish coats per FFD 15.10.3. No prime on sound latex. NOT RECOMMENDED — spray preferred.
Maximum effort. Full remediation + state-driven prime + 3 brush finish coats. 4 total coats, 3 interstage cycles. Near-worst-case labor scenario.
Factory lacquer/catalyzed varnish cabinets. Bonding primer mandatory regardless of condition. Post-primer adhesion test gate critical.
Thermofoil cabinets. Go/no-go gate (delamination = not paintable). Mechanical scuff only (NO chemical degloss). Bonding primer with post-primer adhesion test.

Total SF of cabinet interior surfaces.

Total LF of cabinet-to-wall caulk joints for assess/replace.
Room count for setup/cleanup, assessment, and FIXED-time tasks.
Floor area requiring protection in cabinet work zone. RP always has finished floors.
Perimeter floor protection for brush method.
Countertop surface area requiring protection. CRITICAL: high-value surfaces.
Linear footage of backsplash requiring masking.
Wall area requiring masking for spray overspray. Walls always finished in RP — mandatory for spray.
Ceiling area requiring masking for spray overspray.
Number of appliances requiring protection. ALWAYS required in RP — appliances always present in occupied homes.
Post-work vacuum cleanup area.
Height classification for frame tasks (standard_8ft, tall_9_10ft, extra_tall_11_12ft).
Condition scale (GOOD/FAIR/POOR) — primary prep intensity driver.
Interior substrate state (SS_INT_SOUND_PAINT through SS_INT_SMOKE_DAMAGE) — drives primer selection.
Factory finish type (painted_latex, painted_oil, lacquer, catalyzed_varnish, thermofoil, unknown) — drives primer routing.
Thermofoil flag — triggers assessment gate and modified prep workflow.

material_systems_summary.name: Interior Adhesion Primer
material_systems_summary.notes: Water-based adhesion promoter. MANDATORY for painted_oil (latex-over-oil). Conditional for painted_latex (skip if adhesion test passes on low-sheen). Always for failing/peeling.

material_systems_summary.name: Bonding Primer for Factory Lacquer/Catalyzed Varnish/Thermofoil
material_systems_summary.notes: Enhanced bonding primer for extremely hard non-porous factory finishes. Mandatory regardless of condition. Thermofoil requires adhesion test gate BEFORE priming.

material_systems_summary.name: Interior Stain-Blocking Primer (Shellac)
material_systems_summary.notes: Shellac-based stain blocker (BIN or equivalent). Only product that seals nicotine/smoke. Full surface application. Denatured alcohol cleanup.

material_systems_summary.name: Interior Mildew-Resistant Primer
material_systems_summary.notes: Mildew-resistant primer with antimicrobial additives. Gate: moisture source must be resolved. Under-sink and bath vanity primary targets.

material_systems_summary.name: Standard Acrylic Trim Enamel (QT3)
material_systems_summary.notes: Standard acrylic enamel. Also used for cabinet interiors regardless of exterior tier.

material_systems_summary.name: Modified Urethane Trim Enamel (QT4)
material_systems_summary.notes: Waterborne alkyd. STRONGLY recommended for all cabinet work. Superior hardness, blocking resistant.

material_systems_summary.name: Premium Urethane Trim Enamel (QT5)
material_systems_summary.notes: Premium acrylic-urethane enamel. Maximum durability. 3 brush coats per FFD 15.10.3.

module_summary.description: Floor protection, countertop/backsplash masking, wall/ceiling masking (spray), appliance protection (ALWAYS in RP), plumbing/electrical masking, contents verification, hardware removal (paint scoring for painted-over RP hardware), door/drawer removal
Condition inspect, adhesion test (ASTM D3359), coating ID (4-solvent), moisture check, thermofoil gate (conditional), lead screen (conditional pre-1978). 100% RP_NEW
Shared lead-safe RRP module. Conditional on pre-1978 + lead positive. Cabinets are HIGH RISK for lead paint
Grease wash (mandatory kitchen), degloss (4 item types + chemical), scrape/feather (FAIR/POOR), damage repair, caulk assess/replace, mildew/smoke treatment, vacuum
State-driven + factory-finish-type-driven primer: spray/brush variants for frames, doors, drawers, interiors. Post-primer adhesion test gate
Clean area, inspect coat, sand between (frames SF, doors EA, drawers EA, interior SF), patch defects, spot coat, tack clean. Runs between each coat pair
Spray/brush finish on frames, doors, drawers, interiors. Final inspection and touch-up. 2 coats QT3-QT4, 3 coats QT5 brush

Cure period (5-7 day, separate mobilization), door/drawer/hardware reinstall, hinge adjustment, reinstall touch-up, contents replacement coordination, customer walkthrough, protection teardown, final vacuum, tool cleanup

round_configurations_summary.name: State-Driven Prime + 2 Finish Coats
round_configurations_summary.notes: Most common RP round. Also applies to GOOD condition with painted_oil or factory lacquer/thermofoil.

round_configurations_summary.name: 2 Finish Coats (No Prime)
round_configurations_summary.notes: Simplest RP round — cosmetic color change on sound latex.

round_configurations_summary.name: 3 Finish Coats (QT5 Brush, No Prime)
round_configurations_summary.notes: QT5 brush adds 3rd finish coat per FFD 15.10.3.

stacking_partition.prep_pool: condition_scale x door_style (door/drawer tasks) x height (frame tasks) x kitchen_complexity (frame/protection tasks)
stacking_partition.coating_pool: quality_tier x door_style (door/drawer tasks) x height (frame tasks) x kitchen_complexity (frame/protection tasks)
stacking_partition.never_cross: Prep pool never includes QT. Coating pool never includes condition_scale.

protection_zones_required.notes: Full kitchen floor coverage for spray. RP always has finished floors.
Drop cloth runners at cabinet base for brush.
CRITICAL: high-value surfaces (granite, quartz, marble). Always installed in RP.
Tile backsplash masking. Always present in RP kitchen.
Wall masking for spray. Walls ALWAYS finished in RP — mandatory.
Ceiling fixtures and under-cabinet lighting. Includes ceiling masking for spray.
Full appliance wrap. ALWAYS in RP — appliances always present in occupied homes.
Hardware removed, bagged, and labeled. RP adds scoring for painted-over hardware.
Plumbing in sink base, electrical outlets/switches, under-cabinet lighting.
RP-NEW: cabinet contents must be emptied. Homeowner empties, painter verifies.

adjacent_surfaces.notes: Cabinet frame meets wall. Different finish. RP walls are always finished — full masking for spray.
Upper cabinet tops near ceiling. Crown molding bridges gap if integral to cabinet.
Door overlays frame. Same finish. Doors removed during painting.
Frame edge meets interior. Interior typically QT3 vs exterior QT.
Lower cabinet frame-to-countertop junction. CRITICAL protection for high-value surfaces.

valid_input_states.notes: All 5 SS_INT_* states accepted. Different components may have different substrate states. Worst state at component level drives condition_scale.

adjacent_state_protection_rules.notes: RP walls are ALWAYS finished. Full masking mandatory for spray.
Countertops always installed in RP. CRITICAL high-value protection.

site_condition_rules.affects: customer walkthrough, contents verification, appliance protection
site_condition_rules.notes: Cabinet RP is ALWAYS occupied home context. Appliance protection always required.
Pre-1978 + lead-positive activates MOD_RRP_INT_CONTAINMENT. Cabinets are HIGH RISK for lead paint.
active_moisture is STOP WORK — do not proceed until source is resolved.
Grease is kitchen-specific. Mildew conditional on SS_INT_MOISTURE_DAMAGE. Smoke conditional on SS_INT_SMOKE_DAMAGE.

cross_spec_coordination.deduplication_note: MOD_RRP_INT_CONTAINMENT is shared across all interior RP specs — do not duplicate lead-safe tasks when running cabinet RP alongside wall/trim/door RP.
cross_spec_coordination.shared_session_note: Cabinet RP is typically the LAST interior RP scope in occupied homes. Sequencing: wall RP first (remove cabinet protection zone overlap concern), then trim RP, then cabinet RP (minimizes dust contamination on wet cabinet finishes).

sequencing_notes.production_sequence: Setup (protect + contents verify + hardware/door/drawer removal) > Assess (condition/adhesion/coating/moisture/thermofoil/lead) > [RRP if pre-1978] > Prep (grease wash, degloss, scrape/feather, damage repair, caulk, treatment, vacuum) > Prime (state-driven, if required) > Adhesion test > Interstage > Finish 1 > Interstage > Finish 2 > [QT5 brush: Interstage > Finish 3] > Final Inspect > Touch-up > 5-7 DAY CURE (separate mobilization) > Reinstall doors/drawers/hardware > Hinge adjust > Reinstall touch-up > Contents replacement > Customer walkthrough > Protection teardown > Vacuum > Tool cleanup
sequencing_notes.two_mobilization_note: Visit 1: assess/prep/prime/finish. Visit 2 (after 5-7 day cure): reinstall/touchup/cleanup. Scheduling constraint.
sequencing_notes.key_prohibitions: NO painting over active moisture. NO latex primer on smoke damage (shellac only). NO chemical degloss on thermofoil (solvents damage vinyl). NO skipping interstage sanding on cabinets — all tiers. NO skipping grease wash on kitchen cabinets.

relationships.notes: Cabinet RP is typically the LAST interior RP scope — after walls, ceilings, trim, doors. Minimizes dust contamination on wet cabinet finishes. NC sibling is SF_CABINET_NC_PAINT_v1 (58 tasks vs RP 80 tasks).

sections_used: Shellac stain-blocker mandate for smoke damage (RC-002)
Semi-Exposed Interior Standard (cabinet interiors always QT3)

inherited_research_corrections.corrected_to: Latex/acrylic primers have zero stain blocking capability. Shellac (BIN) is mandatory for smoke damage.
No dry times in specs — refer to product PDS.
Material systems are suggestions per QT — contractor has discretion.
Both Advance (waterborne alkyd) and Emerald Urethane (acrylic-urethane enamel) have SHORT working times.

change_log.author: SpecFactory Assembly Agent
change_log.changes: Initial spec.json assembly from 5 pipeline artifacts (research, resolution, materials, sop_modules, production). QA Critic found 1 major issue (SOP task count metadata mismatch binary=52/qt_scaled=28 declared vs binary=55/qt_scaled=25 actual) — FIXED in sop_modules.json. Zero critical issues. 80 tasks across 8 modules (7 owned MOD_CBRP_* + 1 shared MOD_RRP_INT_CONTAINMENT), 7 material systems (4 RP primer + 3 QT-driven fine-finish), 4 round configurations, 10 protection zones (highest of any interior RP spec), 6 adjacent surfaces, 22 PaintScope inputs, 12 variants, 5 modifiers (condition_scale, door_style, quality_tier, height, kitchen_complexity). Combined 4-item architecture (door EA, drawer EA, frame SF, interior SF conditional). Double-dimension primer routing (condition + factory finish type). Thermofoil go/no-go gate. Kitchen grease mandatory. Post-primer adhesion test gate. Two-mobilization workflow. Highest-complexity interior RP spec.
